# `aitbc grant disburse`

Disburse funds for a grant or a specific milestone.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc grant disburse [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--grant-id` | text | — | yes | The Grant id. |
| `--milestone-id` | text | — | no | Milestone to disburse |
| `--amount` | text | — | no | Amount to disburse (decimal string) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc grant disburse --grant-id <grant_id>
```
